guardrails.message: Redirect toward an inflammatory/autoimmune neuropathy pathway only when the alternative diagnosis convincingly explains the phenotype. Persistent ATTR red flags, axonal progression, multisystem involvement, or treatment nonresponse should reopen ATTRv evaluation.

REDIRECT TO AL EVALUATION / AMYLOID TYPING when characteristic AL features or monoclonal-protein evidence is present. Do not label AL from a screening atom alone, and do not suppress ATTR solely because MGUS/monoclonal gammopathy is present; coexistence is possible.
AA differential requires BOTH a chronic active inflammatory/autoinflammatory/infectious driver AND a new persistent proteinuric renal phenotype.

ATTR cardiac-pathway redirection only. Do not infer ATTRwt from phenotype, age, sex, or absence of neuropathy; TTR genotyping is required to distinguish hereditary from wild-type disease. Coexisting neuropathy/dysautonomia does not block this redirection.
